item.title: Iran says indirect talks with U.S. on ceasefire proposal continue
item.description: Iran says the U.S. is seeking changes to a seven-day ceasefire proposal Trump rejected last month as indirect talks continue.

item.title: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion for misleading users on Facebook privacy
item.description: A judge ordered Meta to pay New Mexico $25 billion after a jury found the company liable for misleading users about privacy and content moderation ...

item.title: Vance criticizes GOP "whining" over anti-Acton ad featuring estranged mother
item.description: Vice President JD Vance said Wednesday he is "disgusted" with Republicans "whining" about an attack ad from Vivek Ramaswamy in the Ohio governor's race ...

item.title: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion to New Mexico in data privacy ruling
item.description: A jury found that the social media company had deceived consumers for years about its data privacy policies.
